title: Role
description: Who does the work. A role is technology-agnostic; traits, packs and the project profile specialise it.

permission.description: read = Read/Grep/Glob; write adds Edit/Write; exec adds Bash.

tools.description: Plain list replaces the tools derived from permission; '+X' / '-X' adjust them.

slots.description: Placeholders traits may fill. Defaults to ['traits']; '+x' adds to the default.

produces.description: Contract name (kernel/contracts/<name>.schema.json) of the structured result this role puts under handoff.output.

abstract.description: true = only the variants become agents, not the role itself.

variants.description: Named specialisations, each built as its own agent <prefix><role>-<variant>. Values are overrides of this role.

engines.description: Engine-specific passthrough, e.g. { claude-code: { color: blue } }.
